caption:
Friday close: Nasdaq +1.09%, S&P 500 +0.31%, Dow -0.46%, but all three ended the week lower (AP, CNBC).

Eight big chip stocks won back about 36% of Thursday's loss on average, from Broadcom's 6% to Intel's 67% (StockTitan). Week: Nasdaq -3.37%, S&P 500 -2.68%, Dow -0.94%.

Swipe for the chip recovery, biggest movers and what's next: CPI on Tuesday, Nov 10.
